metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Trace Schema (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Measures • Paradox • Consent • RTT • Collapse • Lineage
metadata.description: Defines the authoritative schema for session traces in FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Session traces MUST record RTT node transitions, measure IDs, paradox events, consent state, lineage, and collapse.

field_definitions.substrate_class: One of: agentic, parametric, symbolic, edge.
field_definitions.steps: Ordered list of RTT node transitions.

field_definitions.operator: Operator executed at this RTT node.
field_definitions.paradox_events: List of typed paradox events or empty list.
field_definitions.collapse_state: null unless RTT12; MUST be 'collapsed' at RTT12.

measure_rules: All measures MUST be numeric in [0,1].
Every threshold MUST cite a measure ID.
paradox_rules: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
Paradox MUST be one of the canonical types.
consent_rules: If operator_consent = false, escalation MUST be refused.
Consent conflicts MUST be logged as paradox.consent_conflict.
rtt_rules: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
lineage_rules: Lineage MUST be non-decreasing across RTT1–RTT12.
Continuity (measure.c3) MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
substrate_rules: Non-agentic substrates MUST NOT escalate harmonically.
Operators MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
projection_rules: dashboard, overlay, and UI files are projections only.
Authoritative session files are: state, log, alignments.
Projections MUST NOT contradict authoritative files.

non_claims: This schema does not revise RTT v0.9.
This schema does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
This schema does not replace the human FFT book.
